'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Nelson DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Username:''' Airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
